outcome: HMO-bound fucose levels in human milk
cohort: The study included 164 healthy breastfeeding mothers.
finding: While no association was found between maternal fiber intake and HMO-bound fucose levels, delivery mode, secretor status, and infant sex emerged as dominant factors associated with HMO fucosylation in human milk.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery negatively correlated with the level of HMO-bound fucose.
